note: Rankings reflect the 3.7 meta; editorial opinion based on community tier lists.

members.name: Denia
members.note: SS overall on the Game8 3.7 tier list (SS in both ToA and WhiWa); the premier sub-DPS for Fusion Burst and Tune Strain comps.

members.name: Galbrena
members.note: Placed in the top DPS tier across current tier lists for her split Heavy/Echo scaling and extremely high damage output.

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Most October 2026 lists keep her at the top (SS on Beebom 3.7, SS on PocketTactics, S on MMO Culture 3.6), but GachaGo's October 2026 update demoted her to A.

members.name: Qingxiao
members.note: SS overall, SS in ToA and S+ in WhiWa on the Game8 3.7 tier list; the premier Aero Tune Strain DPS.

members.name: Yangyang Xuanling
members.note: SS overall on the Game8 3.7 tier list; one of the strongest 3.x DPS units with some of the highest DMG multipliers in the game.

members.name: Aemeath
members.note: Premier Fusion carry with one of the highest damage ceilings in 3.7.

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: Elite Glacio hypercarry; the Chafe mechanic's best payoff.

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The new premier Electro DPS; defines 3.7's Unison and Electro Flare meta.

members.name: Iuno
members.note: Top-tier Heavy Attack buffer and healer; core of the best Fusion and Aero teams.

members.name: Jingran
members.note: Premier Fusion Heavy Attack hypercarry; anchors a top meta team.

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: S overall on the Game8 3.7 tier list (S+ in Tower of Adversity as of the Oct 12 update); best-in-class WhiWa AoE clearer.

members.name: Lucilla
members.note: Best-in-slot Glacio Chafe support; niche, but unmatched inside her teams.

members.name: Lucy
members.note: Game8 rates her S as a Main DPS / Tower of Adversity unit and Beebom's October 2026 tier list places her in S, citing high front-loaded damage gated by team options tied to Rebecca. MMO Culture's 3.6 list instead ranks her in A, noting a damage ceiling below newer 3.x DPS; tier is therefore marked uncertain.

members.name: Lupa
members.note: S-tier sub-DPS/support — the buffer that defines and enables premium mono-Fusion teams.

members.name: Luuk Herssen
members.note: Sustained aerial Tune Strain DPS with top-tier boss damage, but very dependent on Lynae and Mornye.

members.name: Lynae
members.note: Premier Spectro sub-DPS; a universal Liberation amplifier for burst teams.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Top Fusion support; heals, buffs, and accelerates Off-Tune teams.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: S in Beebom's October 2026 (3.7) tier list and S-rank Sub-DPS on Game8's role ranking; MMO Culture's September (3.6) list had her at A, largely because her best teams are tied to Lucy.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Still the game's best sustain; Crit buffs that fit literally every team.

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Top Aero DPS and Echo Skill scaler; a single-target monster.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: The Negative Status support; raises stack caps for every status team.

members.name: Zani
members.note: Sources disagree on her current standing: Beebom's October 2026 version 3.7 tier list keeps Zani in S, while GachaGo's October 2026 list dropped her to C (from B) citing newer competition, and MMO Culture's v3.6 list has her at A. She remains strong in dedicated Frazzle teams but is no longer a universal top pick.

members.name: Augusta
members.note: Devastating Electro DPS; slightly edged out by newer carries.

members.name: Camellya
members.note: Recent lists place her mostly at A (Beebom 3.7, Pocket Gamer); power creep and her long rotation have pushed the former meta carry down from her peak.

members.name: Cantarella
members.note: Game8 (updated Aug 2026) rates her S inside the Havoc Echo Skill comp with Phrolova. Consensus across lists (Beebom 3.7, MMO Culture, Pocket Gamer) is A — treat her as A overall, S-level inside her signature comp.

members.name: Carlotta
members.note: Solid Glacio DPS, but Hiyuki has taken her crown.

members.name: Cartethyia
members.note: Still an elite Aero Erosion DPS; power-crept but far from dead.

members.name: Changli
members.note: Solid Fusion sub-DPS and quickswap option; outpaced by newer DPS units but still viable with investment.

members.name: Chisa
members.note: Best Havoc Bane support for status teams, but needs the right team around her.

members.name: Ciaccona
members.note: Essential Aero Erosion enabler; her support value keeps her high.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Shot up the ranks in 3.7 as Hsin's best Electro Flare battery.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: A-tier in Beebom's Oct 2026 (Version 3.7) and MMO Culture's Sep 2026 (Version 3.6) tier lists. Launch-era lists had her S; the current meta no longer revolves around Spectro Frazzle, but she remains Zani's best partner.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Best-in-slot for top Echo-skill teams but replaceable by Lucilla/Shorekeeper elsewhere.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Best free 4-star sub-DPS; a great buffer, outscaled by limited 5-stars.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Free, universal healer and buffer; every account's safety net.

members.name: Xiangli Yao
members.note: Beebom's Oct 2026 v3.7 list and Game8's endgame ranks place him at A; MMO Culture (3.6) and Pocket Gamer rank him B. Outclassed by newer DPS like Augusta.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Current v3.6-3.7 lists (Beebom Oct 2026, MMO Culture, Game8) all place her at A; older 1.x-era lists had her at S. Her ceiling is higher on favorable Glacio/ToA cycles.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Handy Electro Flare support for Hsin teams on a budget.

members.name: Encore
members.note: Still a strong standard-banner Fusion carry with a fun quickswap kit, but power-crept by newer Fusion DPS.

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Former queen of the meta; now needs heavy investment to keep up.

members.name: Mortefi
members.note: Budget Heavy Attack buffer; does the job for free.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Free and flexible; replaced once limited options arrive.
